422.description:
**MEDIA_FETCH_FAILED**: The media of a send could not be downloaded from its URL: the server failed, redirected, was too slow, or the file is larger than MAX_MEDIA_BYTES.

**IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED**: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.

**NUMBER_NOT_ON_WHATSAPP**: The phone number is not registered on WhatsApp.

**POLICY_BLOCKED**: The send policy rejected the message by a rule that has no code of its own; details.rule names the rule.

**DUPLICATE_CONTENT**: The same text was already sent to too many different chats in a short time (rule of the send policy).

**RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED**: The chat is on the suppression list of the session (rule of the send policy).

**RECIPIENT_UNREACHABLE**: The chat is flagged unreachable, so cold sends to it are rejected (rule of the send policy).

502.description:
**UNKNOWN_OUTCOME**: The send timed out after it was dispatched, so whether it reached WhatsApp is unknown; it is never retried automatically.

**ACK_ERROR**: WhatsApp reported a delivery error (ack -1) for the message.

**WHATSAPP_ERROR**: WhatsApp Web failed to carry out the operation. `details.kind: "mapping"` marks the case where the operation ran but the gateway could not read its answer (a send made through the send queue ends as `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` in that case).

504.description:
**POLICY_DELAY_EXCEEDED**: The send policy kept the message waiting longer than SEND_POLICY_MAX_WAIT_MS, so it was given up.

**WHATSAPP_TIMEOUT**: WhatsApp Web did not answer within WA_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS.

413.description: **PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE**: The request body is larger than the route accepts: 1 MiB in general, 40 MiB on the routes that send media.

**MEDIA_FETCH_FAILED**: The media of a send could not be downloaded from its URL: the server failed, redirected, was too slow, or the file is larger than MAX_MEDIA_BYTES.

**IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED**: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request.

**NUMBER_NOT_ON_WHATSAPP**: The phone number is not registered on WhatsApp.

**POLICY_BLOCKED**: The send policy rejected the message by a rule that has no code of its own; details.rule names the rule.

**DUPLICATE_CONTENT**: The same text was already sent to too many different chats in a short time (rule of the send policy).

**RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED**: The chat is on the suppression list of the session (rule of the send policy).

**RECIPIENT_UNREACHABLE**: The chat is flagged unreachable, so cold sends to it are rejected (rule of the send policy).

429.description: **RATE_LIMITED**: The API key or the client address sent more than RATE_LIMIT_MAX requests in a minute; wait the seconds in the Retry-After header.

**UNKNOWN_OUTCOME**: The send timed out after it was dispatched, so whether it reached WhatsApp is unknown; it is never retried automatically.

**ACK_ERROR**: WhatsApp reported a delivery error (ack -1) for the message.

**WHATSAPP_ERROR**: WhatsApp Web failed to carry out the operation. `details.kind: "mapping"` marks the case where the operation ran but the gateway could not read its answer (a send made through the send queue ends as `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` in that case).

post.summary: Send a message through an inbound hook
post.description: No API key: the token in the URL is the credential, and it sends through the session of its hook only. The body is the one of `messages.send`, or the short `{ "to", "text" }`, which sends a text. The message takes the same path as any other send (the send queue, the send policy, the pacing), answers 201 with the message or 202 with the job like `messages.send` does, and honors `Idempotency-Key` and `wait`. A hook accepts `INBOUND_HOOK_MAX_PER_MINUTE` requests a minute (`429 RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`), on top of the allowance of the address. A malformed, unknown or revoked token is the same `401`. The body is limited to 1 MiB, so media goes by `source.url` or `source.messageId`, not as base64.
